agents.note:
US-505 DONE (Sprint 69 / V0.29.24, 5/11 -- US-504 carved so the sprint is now 11 stories). READ THIS FIRST, IT IS THE PROCESS SIGNAL: US-505 was ALREADY fully implemented and green, but the prior iteration left it UNCOMMITTED -- the exact TD-059 stall, and the SECOND CONSECUTIVE story it has hit (US-504b was recovered the same way one commit earlier). Two in a row is a pattern, not bad luck: the work gets done, the synchronous gate + commit at the end of the iteration does not. This iteration re-ran the gate, verified rather than trusted the prior work, and committed it (65de58d). If a future iteration boots and finds a dirty tree with untracked src/ + tests/ matching the claimed taskid, that is this stall -- VERIFY AND COMMIT it, do not re-implement.

WHAT US-505 IS: the idle-home LAST DRIVE tile read 'No recent drive' PERMANENTLY, not 'until the next drive'. It had only drive.driveId to read, which is the ACTIVE drive and is null whenever nothing is recording; no producer for the most recent COMPLETED drive existed anywhere. The absence was real -- it was the absence of a PRODUCER, which is why it could never have self-corrected after a drive. New pi/obdii/last_drive_summary.py reads Pi-local drive_summary (US-206) for the newest data_source='real' drive. AC2's SOURCE-CONFIRM grooming gate is RESOLVED in favour of drive_summary, and B-104 is respected rather than worked around: identity + start wall-time ONLY, no distance/duration/max/avg, because derived per-drive analytics became the SERVER's authority when US-351 retired the Pi-side drive_statistics table.

THE DESIGN CALLS THE PM SHOULD KNOW: (1) the anchor is drive START, not end -- drive_summary has NO end-of-drive column, and synthesising one from the newest realtime_data sample would be a guess dressed as a measurement, doubly so while capture is down (BL-025). (2) Age is formatted at DISPLAY time from the carried timestamp, never baked at emit -- a pre-computed '2 h ago' freezes and ages visibly wrong on a kiosk that emits every few seconds but is read minutes later (same pattern the battery card already uses with lastHealthCheckTs). (3) Sim rows are FILTERED, not relabelled: a physics_sim bench run shown as 'your last drive' would be a fabrication in the only terms the panel has -- so on a simulator-only box the tile correctly reads 'No recent drive', which is the single most likely thing to be mistaken for a regression (logged at debug distinguishably from 'no rows at all' for exactly that reason). (4) agoText extends the EXISTING ageText vocabulary downward and hands back to it at a day, rather than declaring a second age enum for the same fact -- the cross-module enum-identity drift that cost the 9-drain saga.

Honest-instrument is per HALF: a drive with a missing/unparseable start stamp still renders the drive and admits 'age unknown' (the drive genuinely happened; hiding it would lose a real fact to protect a cosmetic one), and a FUTURE stamp reads 'just now' not a negative age -- the Pi has no RTC battery and boots before NTP settles, so a stamp ahead of now is a routine transient. Boot-order trap avoided for the FOURTH time this sprint (US-501/502/504b): the database is resolved via getattr AT USE TIME.

THE TEST THAT MATTERS: the producer's SQL is pinned to the REAL schema -- the test builds the table from production SCHEMA_DRIVE_SUMMARY, not a hand-rolled fake, so a column-name drift fails LOUDLY instead of silently degrading to the permanent 'unknown' this story exists to delete. A fake-DB test would sail straight through that. Plus the now-standard real-emitter -> real-state-file -> real-carousel.js chain test under node (US-494/499/502/503 shape). Green in-loop: 196 passed, exit 0, ZERO skips; ruff clean on 8 files.

FLAG FOR PM AT CLOSE: card_state_emitter.py is now a base-module touch for the THIRD time this sprint (US-502, US-504b, US-505) and buildSystemStatusState gained a kwarg -- prioritise the full-suite regression + mypy at integration. OWED on US-505: live validation folds into the post-BL-025 drive per the story's own conditionalOutcome; until a real drive is captured the tile honestly reads 'No recent drive'.

SPRINT STATE: 5 done (US-501/502/503/504b/505). Remaining: US-504a (needs-ruling -- BLOCKED on 2 rulings: PM/Atlas orphan policy + Spool's gate/band overlap; do NOT start it), US-512 BT transport-reset, US-513 rfkill RCA, US-517 home-location config, US-518 sync re-anchor, US-521 gyro-fused pitch. Next pickup by priority is US-512.
